dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL dialect used in Japanese medical billing system

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical association standard receipt (claims) processing system - facility standard information settings (W03 screen)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It handles the facility standard information settings screen (W03), managing system administration master data including validity periods and standard codes. It performs database select/read operations against tbl_syskanri and related tables, and controls screen navigation and SPA (scratchpad area) management.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (59 copybooks) for screen layouts and data structures
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA parameters
MCP (Message Control Program) interface pattern typical of ORCA
SPA (Scratchpad Area) pattern for screen state management
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT dispatch pattern
No EXEC SQL - uses MCP database abstraction layer
verdict.notes: Source contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded as latin-1 causing mojibake in comments. File is truncated at 16000 chars but structure is clear. This is a well-known open-source Japanese medical billing system (JMA ORCA). The MCP interface is ORCA-specific middleware, not CICS, though the program_type is online/interactive.
